obs.source: WAQI (SIATA/AMVA network), AQI back-converted US-EPA-2024, network mean, anchors excluded

about: Self-checking live forecast: the frozen 2018-2024 anchor model driven by GEOS-CF forecast fields (CFAPI), scored as live observations land. Day-ahead = newest issuance >= 12 h old. Live obs are AQI-back-converted (approximate); the 2023 backtest used raw ug/m3 station data.
